City of Encinitas
Special City Council Meeting - Homeless Action Plan 4:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 11, 2026 -
04:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
Status update regarding the implementation of the Homeless Action Plan (HAP). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in a direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Persons: Homeless Programs Coordinator Pugh and Planning Manager Anders
Receive a report and status update regarding the implementation of the HAP and receive City Council direction on the 2026 - 2031 HAP progress update draft and the proposed three community outreach meetings to gather public input on the draft document.
2026-02-11 Special Meeting - Status Update Homeless Action Plan
2026-02-11 Special Meeting - Status Update Homeless Action Plan - Staff Presentation
2026-02-11 Special Meeting - Status Update Homeless Action Plan - Public Comment
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
